description: IELTS Academic Reading: 60 minutes, 40 questions, 3 long passages. L1 Foundation covers the basics: skimming, scanning, time management, and True/False/Not Given. Advanced question types (matching headings, Yes/No/Not Given, matching features) arrive in L2-L4.
source: IELTS Academic Reading test format — ielts.org (British Council / IDP / Cambridge English)
title: Reading
